summary: Inspects the working-tree diff for the Gizmo Pi integration and then reads the Pi SDK's resource-loader, extension loader, sdk, agent-session-services, and skills modules from the pnpm-managed package to understand extension discovery, provider registration timing, and skill loading semantics. A small Node REPL test (via a here-doc script) confirms that `path.relative` returns an absolute path on Windows when project and skill paths live on different drives, which would let a global skill incorrectly appear inside the project scope.
errors: First attempt at the Node path.relative experiment failed with SyntaxError: Invalid hexadecimal escape sequence because the `\U` in `\Users\mchan\...` was parsed as a unicode escape; the test was rewritten using String.raw inside a quoted heredoc and then ran successfully.
